verdict.rationale: Codegen's agent connects to issue trackers (Linear, Jira, ClickUp, Monday.com) and can update statuses, add comments and create tasks, and it can be triggered programmatically via the SDK/API. These are building blocks a user could prompt into a triage workflow, but nothing documents triage as a feature. Missing for 10: any documented automatic triage of incoming issues, severity suggestion, owner routing or assignment, an event trigger on new issues, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
